data.name: Bodhi
data.gender_notes: Bodhi is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘bodh’, meaning ‘to awaken’, ‘enlightened’, or ‘knowledge’. In Hinduism, Bodhi is associated with the enlightenment of Buddha. The tree under which Buddha gained enlightenment is called the Bodhi tree. The name Bodhi carries the meaning “Awakened, Enlightened” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bodhi usually hope their child will grow to embody awakened, enlightened and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Bodhi belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Awakened, Enlightened.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bodhi total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

The name is also associated with the Bodhi tree, which symbolizes wisdom, enlightenment, and spiritual growth.

The name embodies the aspirations of seeking the ultimate truth and striving for personal growth and development in one's spiritual journey.
